schema: module-03-applied-studies literature scan dedup ledger, v1
purpose: Prevent the weekly literature-scan routine from re-surfacing studies already profiled, or already triaged and rejected, in Module 3.
notes: 'rejected' holds studies the routine or a human pass screened in but deliberately did not profile (out of scope, unobtainable full text, duplicate cohort). Record the reason so the same paper is not re-litigated weekly.

runs.window: 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-05 (edat for PubMed C1/C2; submittedDate for arXiv C3) -- last_run_date was null, so the trailing-10-day default window was used
runs.note: C2 (digital-phenotyping-platform PubMed query) and C3-platforms (arXiv) both returned only false positives this run -- 'AWARE'[tiab]/'all:AWARE framework' matched the ordinary adjective 'aware' inside compound ML-paper titles (privacy-aware, mechanobiology-aware, topology-aware, longitudinally-aware), not the AWARE Framework platform. No Beiwe, RADAR-base, mindLAMP, Avicenna, Ethica, MetricWire, m-Path, CARP, or LifeData deployment candidates were found this run. C3-wearables (arXiv) found 1 candidate (SATURN/ABCD-Fitbit), rejected as architecture (secondary ML analysis of existing data, not a deployment-operations report).

runs.source: consolidation of six unmerged scan-routine branches
runs.note: Unioned seen-ID lists and rejections from the 2026-09-07, 09-14, 09-21 and 09-28 runs. 10 queue rows from those runs added to _scan-queue.md. 2 papers rejected by the 2026-10-05 run but queued by an earlier run were moved to the queue, with the rejection reason kept on the row.

runs.source: manual queue screening, 4 agents, full text
runs.note: 16 pending queue papers screened: 7 profiled, 9 rejected (5 unobtainable because the publisher served a bot check; re-screen from a hand-fetched PDF).

runs.window: 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-12 (edat for PubMed C1/C2; submittedDate for arXiv C3)
runs.note: C2 (digital-phenotyping-platform query) returned only false positives again this run, same mechanism as 2026-10-05, on both PubMed and arXiv: 'AWARE framework' matched ordinary English '[X]-aware framework'/'[X]-Aware' constructions in 6 completely unrelated papers -- 4 from PubMed (radiology image retrieval, SUDEP consensus statement, TB granuloma modeling, gut-metagenomic CRC benchmarking) and 2 from arXiv in the 2026-10-05-to-2026-10-12 window (a federated-learning paper matching 'Heterogeneity-aware', an LLM-agent paper matching 'Cost-Aware') -- none naming any Module 2 platform. No Beiwe, RADAR-base, mindLAMP, Avicenna, Ethica, MetricWire, m-Path, CARP, or LifeData deployment candidates were found on either API. C1 (wearables) found 11 PubMed candidates and 0 in-window arXiv candidates; 3 queued (2 Apple Watch feasibility/acceptability studies, 1 Fitbit feasibility/acceptability study), 8 rejected. 4 of the 8 C1 rejections were 'no-cohort' for insufficient signal density -- a real participant cohort existed but only one of the five deployment-reality signal categories was clearly present in the abstract (e.g. an enrolled-vs-analyzed gap, or a wear-time eligibility threshold used as an inclusion criterion rather than reported as an outcome), one notably borderline (10.1016/j.nwh.2026.09.001, substantively about Fitbit data-availability/missingness but only that one signal category). Both arXiv endpoints were reachable this run (export.arxiv.org required https, not http).

runs.window: 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-19 (edat for PubMed C1/C2; submittedDate for arXiv C3)
runs.note: C2 (digital-phenotyping-platform PubMed query) returned 5 hits, all false positives with no Module 2 platform named anywhere in title/abstract (tomato-breeding CRISPR review, gut-metagenomics CRC classifier, chest-X-ray retrieval framework, TB-granuloma cell-death framework, Italian SUDEP consensus statement) -- consistent with this query's history of low precision. C3-platforms (arXiv) returned 7 hits, all the established 'AWARE'-as-ordinary-adjective false-positive pattern (State-Aware, Mode-/Support-Aware, Role-costs-aware, Cost-Aware, etc.) with no Module 2 platform involved; not individually added to the rejected array per this ledger's established practice of not cluttering it with arXiv phrase-matching artifacts that have no DOI (see research-log.md for the list). C1 (wearables) yielded 2 genuine queued candidates (PROPHESY ActiGraph post-cardiac-surgery feasibility study; Roadmap app + Fitbit dementia-caregiver feasibility/acceptability study) out of 16 screened, and 14 rejections -- several were real cohorts with real wearable deployments (TraPCAf Ghana/UK Parkinson's study, Japan corporate-employee Fitbit sleep study, All of Us Fitbit sleep-data-availability study, PST-APPLE Apple Watch RCT) that failed the two-distinct-deployment-signal threshold with only one signal category present each; flagged as notable exclusions below and in research-log.md rather than silently dropped.

Sample-size methods paper; cohorts supply parameters only.

Onnela 2021 perspective.

9 of 74 analysed; keep the 10/74 Android-only comm-log gate as a corroboration of README finding 23.
Fitbit sedentary-bout forecasting framework for CPPD (n=134 females); a missing-data-resilient ML forecasting model, not a deployment-operations report (no retention/adherence/attrition figures).

ActiGraph-measured metabolic-syndrome ML prediction model in 822 adolescents, cross-sectional; explicitly states 'feasibility assessment... required before large-scale screening' i.e. feasibility not yet assessed in this paper.
Garmin Forerunner 265 VO2max/race-prediction accuracy vs reference; device-validation study.

DBS-sensing + Oura Ring synchronization framework (medRxiv preprint); 3-participant technical demonstration of a data-sync pipeline, not a deployment-reality report. Also screened out of Module 1 this pass as a non-peer-reviewed preprint.

Multimodal wearable+lifelog circadian-behavioral-coupling sensing-system feasibility demo, n=10; device is an unbranded 'heat-flux-based wearable temperature sensor' and generic 'wrist-worn actigraph', not identifiable as a Module 1/2-profiled technology. Paper itself frames the contribution as sensor-fusion feasibility, not deployment operations.
BACK.BEAT HRV-biofeedback pilot study protocol (PubMed PublicationType=Clinical Trial Protocol); no results yet.
ActiGraph cut-point/data-processing-protocol comparison in children with T1D (n=43); methodological/analytic comparison on already-collected data, not a deployment-feasibility report.

Oura Ring NFBC1986 cross-sectional depression/anxiety correlational study (n=1,290). Only one deployment-reality signal present (a >=15h wear-time inclusion threshold); no retention, adherence, acceptability, completeness, or technical-failure reporting despite a real cohort -- insufficient signal density per the two-distinct-signals screen.
Single-patient (N=1) Oura Ring case report following DBS for Parkinson's disease; a case report is not a cohort.
Heart Watch Study protocol (Apple Watch 12-lead ECG, planned N=30,000); no results yet, data collection not started at submission.

ActiGraph-measured poverty/movement-behavior longitudinal correlational study (n=66, 1-year follow-up). Only 'longitudinal' signal present; no retention/attrition/adherence/completeness figures reported for the device deployment itself.

SUNRISE Ecuador pilot secondary analysis (ActiGraph, n=108), cross-sectional correlational analysis of movement behaviors vs anthropometrics; 'guideline adherence' refers to a PA-guidelines analytic variable, not device-wear adherence. No retention/attrition/completeness reporting.
Privacy-aware federated-learning analytics on OULAD learning-platform data; false positive from 'AWARE'[tiab] matching 'Privacy-aware' -- no digital-phenotyping platform named.
Mechanobiology-aware antifouling-interface review; false positive from 'AWARE'[tiab] matching 'mechanobiology-aware' -- unrelated to digital phenotyping, no human cohort at all.
LC-MS metabolite retention-time prediction (TC-TopoRT); false positive from 'AWARE'[tiab] matching 'topology-aware' -- no digital-phenotyping platform, no human cohort.
medicalcoder R package for ICD-based comorbidity coding; false positive from 'AWARE'[tiab] matching 'longitudinally aware' -- no digital-phenotyping platform named.

European school-based obesity-prevention-strategy review; no digital-phenotyping platform named in title/abstract despite the C2 query match (likely an 'AWARE'-adjacent token false positive in the full abstract).

SATURN: graph-learning model predicting adolescent crystallized intelligence from 21-day Fitbit records in the ABCD Study (N=6,091). Secondary ML-modeling analysis of an existing large cohort's already-collected data; 'irregular device adherence' and 'invalid-day' pruning appear only as modeling covariates, not as a report of how the Fitbit deployment itself went (no new recruitment/retention/technical-failure reporting).
Validation of heart rate measurements from the Polar Verity Sense during the submaximal Ekblom-Bak test in adults with obesity; PubMed PublicationType explicitly 'Validation Study'.

Fitbit Sense 2 in hospitalized general medicine patients: primary aim is validity of Fitbit-derived HR/steps/sleep/SpO2 vs Nox T3/StepWatch reference devices (Bland-Altman, ICC). Has a secondary feasibility/patient-perception component and data-completeness figures (100%/91%/56%/41% by stream) but core design is device-vs-reference accuracy, consistent with prior 'validation' rejections in this ledger (e.g. PMC12399887).
Remote Assessment of Physical Function and Physical Activity in Adults With Autism Spectrum Disorder: explicitly a study protocol ('Participants complete...'); no results reported yet.
Systematic review of 47 wrist-tracker accuracy studies; also filed in Module 1 as a device-agnostic systematic review under Apple Watch.
ESC/EHRA myocarditis arrhythmia consensus statement; no Module 2 platform named anywhere in the abstract despite matching the C2 grouped query. False positive.
Review of oral nutritional supplements vs the Nova ultra-processed-food classification; no Module 2 platform named anywhere in the abstract despite matching the C2 grouped query. False positive.
Duplicate/co-publication of the same EHRA/HFA myocarditis arrhythmia consensus statement as 10.1093/ejhf/xuag271; no Module 2 platform named in the abstract. False positive.

ActiGraph secondary analysis of OAI cohort activity percentiles; matched on 'longitudinal' describing the parent cohort's design, but reports no retention/adherence/completeness/feasibility figures of its own — fewer than two deployment-reality signals.
False-positive AWARE match — 'uncertainty-aware' framework for coronary hemodynamics (PUNCH), unrelated to the AWARE sensing platform.
False-positive AWARE match — WHO 'AWaRe' antibiotic-classification framework, unrelated to the AWARE sensing platform.

HiGHmed multi-site Apple Watch cardiology dashboard (conference proceedings, Studies in Health Technology and Informatics). A dashboard-tool paper, not a deployment-feasibility report; only 1 of 13 deployment-reality signal terms present in the abstract ('adherence'), fails the routine's 2-signal screening threshold despite a real cohort (93 enrolled, 12 analysed in this sub-study).

Long COVID Fitbit Inspire 3 + FatigueSense app study, N=14, median 28d. Real wearable deployment but purely a within-person correlational/validity analysis (sleep/HRV vs fatigue); only 'longitudinal' matches the deployment-signal vocabulary, fails the 2-signal threshold -- no adherence/retention/completeness reporting.

False positive on the ordinary-word/acronym trap: 'AWARE' here stands for 'AI Use, Why, Attachment, Reality and Risk, and Effect on Functioning' -- a proposed clinical-interviewing framework for assessing patients' conversational-AI use, unrelated to the AWARE mobile-sensing Framework. Viewpoint article, no participant cohort.

m-Path ESM deployment in youth with physical disabilities (N=7, 2 weeks). Real small cohort but 0 of 13 deployment-signal terms present in the abstract; fails the 2-signal threshold. Already logged as a platform-methods addition in module-02-digital-phenotyping/literature-library.md.

FPGA/CNN accelerator for angiographic plaque classification. No Module 1/2 device or platform named; matched the grouped query on 'deployment' in an unrelated (FPGA hardware) sense. Not digital-health-platform relevant.

Conceptual Perspective proposing an infrastructure-aware digital-health evaluation framework, illustrated narratively by the Bright Health program (Kenya/Ethiopia) but reporting no participant-level deployment data of its own and no Module 1/2 profiled technology.
Explicit review/commentary on cancer-diagnostics biomarker strategy; no wearable/phenotyping platform, no deployment cohort.
Trial protocol for the 'Digital Sleep Revolution' OSA diagnostic pathway; design/planned-analyses only, no results yet.
WARN-D study (Oura Ring, rTMS relapse prediction): feasibility protocol; explicitly no participants enrolled and no data collected at submission.

Prospective observational cohort protocol for wrist-accelerometer remote monitoring of RA flare during DMARD tapering; only 16 of a planned 100 recruited as of writing, outcome analyses not yet conducted.

Apple Watch/iPhone spine-surgery mobility study (N=51, 60,753 patient-days) is a clinical-outcomes correlation study (mobility vs. PROMs); no explicit feasibility/retention/adherence framing despite a real cohort.
All of Us Fitbit circadian rest-activity/biological-aging study (N=2,222); epidemiological association study, only 'longitudinal' signal matched, no adherence/retention/completeness reporting.
Polar H10 used only as an HRV-recording instrument in a single-session acute lab crossover breathing study (N=34); not a wearable deployment/feasibility study.

ActiGraph GT9X used only as a covariate-measurement instrument in a cross-sectional adiposity study (N=264 schoolchildren); wear time appears only as an adjustment covariate, no deployment-reality reporting.
ActiGraph+CGM glycemic-variability association study in T2D (N=140); accelerometry is the exposure variable, not the object of a feasibility/deployment report.

Fitbit/All of Us physical-activity-vs-ophthalmic-disease outcome study (n=14,757). Fitbit-derived sleep architecture vs ADHD/externalizing-behavior cross-sectional outcome study in the ABCD cohort (n=4,545). No retention/attrition, adherence/wear-time, feasibility/acceptability, completeness, or technical-failure signal identified in the abstract -- fails the two-distinct-signals screen despite a real cohort.

Sociodemographic correlates of longitudinal Fitbit sleep-data availability among women in the All of Us Research Program (n=7,385, BYOD cohort); substantively about data completeness/missingness, but only that single signal category is present -- no retention/attrition, adherence/wear-time, feasibility/acceptability, or technical-failure reporting. Flagged as a borderline exclusion: thematically close to Module 3's core question but fails the mechanical two-distinct-signals bar as written.
CXR-CoRe chest X-ray report-retrieval framework; false positive from 'AWARE framework'[tiab] matching 'section-aware framework' -- no digital-phenotyping platform, no wearable/smartphone cohort.

Italian expert consensus statement on SUDEP risk/mechanisms/prevention; false positive from 'AWARE framework'[tiab] matching 'mechanism-aware framework' -- no digital-phenotyping platform, no participant cohort (consensus statement, not a deployment study).

Necro-mosaic TB-granuloma cell-death modeling framework; false positive from 'AWARE framework'[tiab] matching 'lesion-aware framework' -- no digital-phenotyping platform, no human participant cohort (lesion/tissue modeling paper).

CRC-TrustBench gut-metagenomic colorectal-cancer classifier benchmark; false positive from 'AWARE framework'[tiab] matching 'leakage-aware framework' -- no digital-phenotyping platform, no participant cohort (metagenomic ML benchmarking paper).

FedRSPO+: A Heterogeneity-aware Algorithm for Decision-focused Federated Learning; false positive from the arXiv C2 'AWARE framework' query matching 'Heterogeneity-aware' -- unrelated federated-learning paper, no digital-health content, no participant cohort.

Selective Critique for Cost-Aware LLM Agents in Long-Horizon Decision Making; false positive from the arXiv C2 'AWARE framework' query matching 'Cost-Aware' -- unrelated LLM-agent paper, no digital-health content, no participant cohort.

Chronic-pelvic-pain-disorder IPAQ-vs-Fitbit construct-validity study (N=112, 966 person-weeks); explicitly a measurement-validity study (concordance/temporal-consistency of self-report vs. tracker), not a deployment-operations report.

TraPCAf Ghana/UK Parkinson's-disease digital-mobility comparison study (Axivity AX6, N=50 PD + 30 controls, 7-day wear). Real cohort, but only one deployment-reality signal category present ('Feasibility and acceptability were high, although discomfort was commonly reported'); no retention/adherence-percentage/completeness/technical-failure reporting -- fails the two-distinct-signal threshold.

All of Us longitudinal Fitbit + polygenic-score major-depressive-disorder study (N=3,030). Epidemiological hazard-model association analysis of already-collected data; only 'longitudinal' matched, no adherence/retention/completeness reporting of its own -- consistent with prior All of Us Fitbit rejections in this ledger.

UK Millennium Cohort Study compositional-data reallocation analysis of ActiGraph GT1M data at age 7 (N=5,145). Secondary analysis of an existing cohort's device data; no deployment-reality signals of its own.

2-participant case report (Apple Watch + Oura ring; Fitbit + Oura ring), 4 months. Feasibility and missing-data signals both present, but PubMed article_type is 'Case Reports' -- same 'a case report is not a cohort' logic already applied to the N=1 Oura/DBS case report (10.7759/cureus.115385) elsewhere in this ledger. Also filed in Module 1's research-library-wearables.md, which has its own, looser relevance bar.

PST-APPLE pilot RCT (Apple Watch-supported problem-solving therapy for college students with alcohol-use-disorder symptoms, N=26). Feasibility/acceptability is the only deployment-reality signal category present; no retention-percentage/adherence-percentage/completeness/technical-failure reporting -- fails the two-distinct-signal threshold. Also filed in Module 1's research-library-wearables.md, which has its own, looser relevance bar.
